definitions.explanation: A very rich person. Old-fashioned on its own; today mostly in compounds such as {億万長者|おくまんちょうじゃ} and {長者番付|ちょうじゃばんづけ}, and in folk tales (わらしべ{長者|ちょうじゃ}).

examples.japanese: ⟦{億万長者|おくまんちょうじゃ}→億万長者：18272_okumanchouja⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なりたい→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I want to be a billionaire.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昔話|むかしばなし}→昔話：12718_mukashibanashi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{村|むら}→村：02261_mura⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{長者|ちょうじゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}てくる→出てくる：29121_detekuru⟧。
examples.english: A rich man of the village appears in the folk tale.

examples.japanese: {長者番付|ちょうじゃばんづけ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上位|じょうい}→上位：11188_joui⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{起業家|きぎょうか}→起業家：14262_kigyouka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ずらり⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{並|なら}んでいる→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: The top of the rich list is lined with the names of entrepreneurs.

notes:
COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{億万長者|おくまんちょうじゃ}→億万長者：18272_okumanchouja⟧: billionaire, multimillionaire
- ⟦{百万長者|ひゃくまんちょうじゃ}→百万長者：31016_hyakumanchouja⟧: millionaire
- {長者番付|ちょうじゃばんづけ}: a rich list
- わらしべ{長者|ちょうじゃ}: the folk tale of a man who trades a straw up to a fortune; anyone who rises by small trades

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{金持|かねも}ち→金持ち：02993_kanemochi⟧: rich person — the everyday word
- ⟦{富豪|ふごう}→富豪：20556_fugou⟧: a person of great wealth — formal
